title: Tablajeria R2 semantic extract after worker bridge mutation
objective: Use the newly integrated worker_result_semantic_extract check to read the large canonical Tablajeria R2 recovery audit result from worker/results and emit explicit semantic fields required to decide whether Gate3 remains HOLD or can be prepared. Do not mutate repository, do not touch SQL, and do not touch Production.
hard_fail_conditions: No actions are allowed; actions must remain [].
Do not touch SQL or Production.
Do not touch Tablajeria business code.
Do not infer Gate3 from chat memory or generic repository audit.
If source_result_read_status is not RESULT_READ_OK, fail closed with gate3_allowed=false.
If semantic_fields_complete is false, keep gate3_allowed=false and report missing_semantic_fields.
If gate3_allowed is true, it must be present explicitly in source semantic fields and source result must be PASS/CERTIFIED/no production/no blockers.
next_after_success_gate3_false: Use missing_semantic_fields or blocking_reason_if_any to prepare the exact next READ_ONLY extraction/audit. Do not mutate Tablajeria.
next_after_success_gate3_true: Prepare Gate3 preflight only; do not execute mutation until explicitly requested.
